description: Which daily CSV logs exist: event log (ev_log/), consumption (c_log/), SDM meter (sdm_log/), per-sensor temperature (t_log_N/), humidity (h_log_N/), universal sensor (u_log_N/). Without kind: the log folders on each volume and the newest event-log days. kind (+channel for temperature/humidity/usens) = every file of that log with size and date. Read one with myio_log. Editor/admin level.
name: myio_logs
title: Log files
